logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.

moments.description: The glowing red branding tip sizzles against the ledger while Juliana trembles in tears against the dungeon wall.
Juliana's despair solidifies into cold conviction as she looks at Catherine and tells her to burn it.
Juliana calmly states that Gerald leaving her was the best thing he ever did.
moments.key_dialogue: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.

moments.description: Juliana reveals she was freed from her toxic marriage and found a true husband who loves her.
moments.key_dialogue: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.

moments.description: Juliana completely strips Catherine bare by telling her she has collected power but never learned how to be loved.
moments.key_dialogue: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.

moments.description: Catherine screams and plunges the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face, stopping mere millimeters from her eye.
moments.key_dialogue: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
